name: Canon EOS R5 C
description: Hybrid cinema camera combining the EOS R5's 45MP full-frame stills with Cinema EOS video features. Records 8K 60p Cinema RAW Light internally and uses active cooling for unlimited recording. Suits solo shooters who need both high-resolution photo and professional video.

specs.in_the_box: EOS R5 C, battery, charger, neck strap, USB cable, cable protector, body cap
specs.shutter_speed_range: Mechanical Shutter1/8000 to 30 SecondsElectronic Front Curtain Shutter1/8000 to 30 SecondsElectronic Shutter1/8000 to 0.5 Seconds

name: Sony FX2
description: Compact full-frame Cinema Line camera built around a 33MP Exmor R sensor. Adds a tilting 3.68M-dot OLED EVF to the FX-series body, records with S-Log3 and S-Cinetone, and uses an AI processing unit for real-time subject recognition AF and active stabilization.

name: Nikon ZR
description: Nikon's compact 6K full-frame cinema camera developed with RED. Records REDCODE RAW (R3D), N-RAW and ProRes with over 15 stops of dynamic range, has a 24.5MP FX sensor, dual base ISO, 32-bit float audio from built-in mics and a bright 4-inch DCI-P3 display.

specs.memory_card: Slot 1: CFexpress Type B, Slot 2: microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC (UHS-I)

name: Panasonic Lumix S5 II
description: Mid-range full-frame hybrid with a 24.2MP sensor and Panasonic's first phase-detection autofocus. Records unlimited 6K 30p and 4K 60p 10-bit video with excellent in-body stabilization.

specs.continuous_shooting: Mechanical ShutterUp to 9 fps for up to 200 Frames (Raw) / 300 Frames (JPEG)Electronic ShutterUp to 30 fps for up to 200 Frames (Raw) / 200 Frames (JPEG)

name: OM System OM-1 Mark II
description: OM System's flagship Micro Four Thirds camera with a 20.4MP stacked BSI sensor. Offers 120 fps bursts, computational modes such as Live ND and handheld high-res, and IP53-rated weather sealing.

name: Fujifilm X100V
description: Premium fixed-lens APS-C compact with a 26.1MP X-Trans CMOS 4 sensor and a newly designed 23mm f/2 lens (35mm equivalent). Features a hybrid optical/electronic viewfinder, weather resistance (with adapter ring and filter) and Fujifilm's film simulation modes. A favorite for street and travel photography.

specs.in_the_box: X100V, NP-W126S battery, USB cable, shoulder strap, body cap, clip, hot shoe cover
specs.film_simulations: 18 modes incl. Provia, Velvia, Classic Chrome, Acros
specs.shutter_speed_range: Mechanical 1/4000 to 900 s, Electronic to 1/32000 s
